crops.name: Red Lettuce
crops.summary: The cheapest video-confirmed seed in the current build: 48C, Spring, 3 days, single harvest. Sell price per head is still unobserved.
crops.searchTags: red lettuce salad vegetable spring seed price grow harvest food sell buy

facts.text: Red Lettuce Seed is sold in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab at 48C (Basic quality).
The historical Alpha record listed Red Lettuce Seeds at 18C — superseded by the current-build 48C observation; kept as a lead only.
Season: Spring · Growth time: 3 days · Multi-harvest: none (one harvest per planting).

Player sell price per head: unknown. Crop income settles as one combined Farming total in the daily settlement, so per-crop sell prices cannot be read off the settlement screen and none is published here.
Theoretical framework only (not an observed outcome): profit per occupied day = (sell price − 48C) ÷ 3 once a sell price is captured.

historical.behavior: Growth time and sale value were not recorded.
historical.tags: red lettuce spring seed price crop

videoRow.details: Season: Spring · Growth time: 3 days · Multi-harvest: none · Quality: Basic.
videoRow.tags: red lettuce seed price 48 spring growth 3 days basic

crops.name: Strawberry
crops.summary: The first video-confirmed regrow crop: 144C seed, Spring, 7 days to first harvest, then fruit every 3 days. Berry sell price is unobserved — the 18C-per-harvest figure is a cost-allocation model, not revenue.
crops.searchTags: strawberry berry berries fruit spring regrow recurring seed price grow harvest sell buy

facts.text: Strawberry Seed is sold in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab at 144C (Basic quality); the purchase dialog separately confirmed 10 seeds = 1,440C.
The historical Alpha record listed Strawberry Seeds at 38C — superseded by the current-build 144C observation; kept as a lead only.
Season: Spring · Growth time: 7 days · Multi-harvest: every 3 days (regrows after the first harvest).
The historical Alpha record claimed daily fruiting after maturity with 10-20 berries per plot and a 20C sale value — Alpha data, not confirmed in the current build.
Player sell price per berry: unknown — never observed on screen, and the daily settlement does not break crop income down per crop.

Theoretical model (our derivation, not an observed outcome): seed-cost allocation ≈ 18C per harvest, assuming eight harvests in a full 30-day Spring (day 7, then days 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28) with no missed regrowth, no season-boundary loss and no plant death. Profit/day = (sell price × yield − allocated seed cost) ÷ 3 — open until a sell price is captured.

historical.behavior: Reported to fruit daily after maturity, yielding 10-20 berries per plot; reported sale value 20C.
historical.tags: strawberry berry berries spring regrow recurring daily fruit yield seed price

videoRow.details: Season: Spring · Growth time: 7 days · Multi-harvest: every 3 days · Quality: Basic. The purchase dialog separately confirmed 10 seeds = 1,440C.
videoRow.tags: strawberry seed price 144 spring growth 7 days multi-harvest every 3 days basic regrow

inputs.name: Fertilizer
inputs.summary: Officially flagged as miscalculating in the current build — the official advice is to avoid investing until it is fixed.
inputs.searchTags: fertilizer ogm boost price bonus yield rare legendary bug

facts.text: Fertilizer retails at 288C (Rare quality) in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab.
Official warning: fertilizer "is not currently calculating correctly", it is being looked into, and players should avoid investing in fertilizer until it is adjusted.
One player's test matches the warning: roughly 8,000C of Legendary fertilizer (covering 8 of 24 plots) added about 79C of sales on a salad harvest.
A second player reported selling 20 onions with 20 OGM and 40 onions with 40 OGM for the same 21,000C — consistent with the official bug warning, single report.

videoRow.details: Quality: Rare. OGM Fertilizer: 1,080C, Legendary (03:21). Boost Fertilizer also exists in the tab; its price was never opened on screen.

inputs.name: OGM Fertilizer
inputs.summary: Premium Legendary tier seen on the shop shelf at 1,080C. Same calculation-bug warning applies as for regular fertilizer.
inputs.searchTags: ogm fertilizer legendary price bonus premium

facts.text: OGM Fertilizer retails at 1,080C (Legendary) — shop detail panel showed Health 6/6, Consumed energy 1/540, and no description text.

inputs.name: Hay
inputs.summary: Not a planted crop — wild grass produces it, and it doubles as chicken feed (see the animal database).
inputs.searchTags: hay wild grass chicken feed bushes crates barrels

facts.text: Wild grass produces hay regardless of its growth stage.
Players report getting hay by chopping bushes or looting crates and barrels on NPC farms.
Hay is the chicken feed — chickens pick grains out of hay/straw piles. Feeding details live in the animal database.

cashin.text: Harvested crops are sold through the CashIn Export Storage Chest by the Cargo/helipad area on the ranch.

Depositing pays nothing immediately — the income lands as one combined Farming total in that day's settlement, so per-crop sell prices cannot be read off the settlement screen and none are published here yet.
